notes.title: Update 1.0.180
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26682756/2b0ae2b56caaf79141cb5a181e93b1bf6e6133c5.jpg[/img]

Dear Hunters,
Hope you all had an amazing New Year!  The final season of NBC Grimm is upon us, and what an awesome Season 6 it has been so far!  

We would also like to welcome all the new players that joined us over the holiday period, and we hope that you are enjoying your adventures so far.

Version 1.0.180 has arrived!  Check out the awesome highlights below 

New Stuff:
•	Reduced the size of all maps from England onwards.
•	Rogue-Lite Warning text has been given a clearer background.
•	Tutorial - Tips that pop up are not so intrusive on screen. 
•	Added an error message if an incorrect email is entered.


Squashed bugs:

•	The traps now deal damage to you (like bombs), but not your party 
               members.
•	Rectified Handmade Gas & Fire traps that don't do any damage to 
               beasts.
•	Made the difficulty disclaimer more visible.
•	Added feedback on the satiety drain if you run with no stamina.
•	Added a tooltip about consulting the map.
•	Added a note about random character generation at character selection 
               screen.
•	Heavy Shield blueprint that couldn’t be crafted.
•	Rectified client hangs in the menu after the game is loaded.
•	Rectified - Audio - the drum sound that plays when you click a new 
               mission cuts off. 
•	Rectified Tutorial Tip "There's a creature nearby! Press Q to sneak up 
              on it." showing when there’s no creature nearby.
•	Rectified Front End- Micro-stutter when sprinting and scouting the area.
•	Rectified thorn bush - does not initially spawn in the correct place 
               before “growing”.
•	Fixed the critical display value for the proper multiplier.


Don’t forget to let us know what you would like to see in the future!

Happy hunting
The Grimm Team

notes.title: Offline Mode - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26682756/f488f97b02edf1de8acb2a4c2ec16e3d9eec1919.jpg[/img]

[b]Offline Single player is now available in Grimm: Dark Legacy![/b]

It’s now possible to jump in and enjoy playing Grimm: Dark Legacy without relying on servers or an internet connection, and without any chance of disturbance from network lag, regardless of where you’re located in the world.

So, whether you just prefer playing solo without disturbance from other players, or just want the assurance that you’ll always be able to play anywhere, anytime, there hasn’t been a better time to start your hunt.

Thanks for your feedback so far, we’re glad to be able to provide this update in response to it!

Keep the feedback coming, we’re listening: Tell us what you think in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/536640/discussions/1/]the forums[/url].

[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

[b]Gameplay Updates[/b]
[list][*]Offline Mode – You can now play offline. 
    [list][*]Offline Mode is achieved by your local PC hosting a local server environment.
[*]Offline Mode is separate from Online mode and characters cannot be transferred between Online and Offline mode.[/list]
[*]Added the Kebab Morsel Recipe
[*]Added Fenrir to the Bestiary[/list]

[b]Balances[/b]
[list][*]Fixed Kebab Morsel Recipe name (was "Cornbread")
[*]Changed the rewards of mission 4.05 for Morsel Kebab recipe and ingredient[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Rectified infinite loading on dynamic maps
[*]Rectified waves of wolves not appear when the countdown timer finishes in the Farmer in Trouble mission
[*]Fixed Hunting missions that could spawn less creatures than the objectives
[*]Creatures don’t aggro other creatures anymore (from Damonfeuer’s attack)
[*]Fixed Mission Objective description of Mission 8.03[/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.0.158
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26682756/cf237b005e2bb25cb5f44bc35bae4c0b351b23c6.jpg[/img]

Dear Hunters,

While we’ve been busy at working on an Offline Mode in response to the huge demand, we’ve fixed many of the most reported issues since Grimm: Dark Legacy launched on Steam last week.

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list][*]Only players of the same party in the same mission can now contribute to completing each other’s mission objectives!
[*]Tier-1 Wolves are now aggressive. You’ve been warned
[*]Increased all weapon damage by approximately 150%[/list]

[h1]Update Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Mission 2.03 has new mission rewards: Minor Swiftness Formula, 2x Purple Mushroom & 1x Phial.
[*]Added more Wood as reward for Mission 1.03 (3->10). Need to get me that Club!
[*]Added 5 Wood to the reward for Mission 1.02. Need to get me that Club!
[*]Tier-1 Wolves are now aggressive. You’ve been warned.
[*]NPC’s in “Locate” missions now create more noise, more frequently so they’re easier to find in missions.
[*]Added a 10s delay between waves of wolves in the first mission.
[*]Removed the “axe” component of axe blueprints due to the randomness of getting these blueprints
[*]Replaced the “shield” component of heavy shield blueprints with a crude shield component due to the randomness of getting these blueprints
[*]Increased all weapon damage by approximately 150%
[*]Fixed critical multiplier on the Hexenbiest’s telekinetic attack
[*]Added fire vulnerability to Bears. 
[*]Added blight vulnerability to Hundjägers. 
[*]Added slash vulnerability to Boars.  
[*]Added puncture vulnerability to Blutbaden.  
[*]Reduced the Kanabo’s hit area and cast time.[/list]

[h1]Squashed Bugs[/h1]
[list][*]Only party members in the same mission can now contribute to completing your mission objectives!
[*]The Dämonfeuer’s fireball now deals damage to other creatures as well as players.
[*]Fixed projectiles doing too much damage (including Bombs and the Hexenbiest’s telekinetic attacks).
[*]Added the “skinned” appearance for Elder Blutbad.
[*]Replaced the term “hub” with “village”.
[*]Renamed the wolves in mission 1.01 to “Young Wolf”.
[*]Hidden the crown value of food in the merchant UI, because you can’t sell food![/list]


We appreciate your patience while we've been building this update! We're waiting to hear what you think, and what you'd like to see in the next update in the comments.

Regards
The Grimm: Dark Legacy Team.

notes.title: Welcome to Grimm: Dark Legacy!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26682756/c89642b3b9b8024b80aafefa439893d51ef931c7.png[/img]

We're incredibly excited to announce the release of Grimm: Dark Legacy on Steam!

We’d like to say a huge thank you to everyone who took part in the BETA phase.  We've been listening closely to your feedback and suggestions, and as a result, we have been busy making changes. 

[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]
We have added in a couple of new features for the release of Grimm: Dark Legacy on Steam!
[list]
[*]You can now choose between Easy, Rogue, and Iron Man Modes. Play at the difficulty setting that best suits your play-style!
[*]Fellow Grimm have reported back that Fenrir, Eater of the World, is on the prowl in Norway... 
[*]New voice overs in every cut-scene. We’re sure you won’t be disappointed.
[*]Removed all micro-transactions - You now own the whole game for a single purchase.
[/list]
[h1]Join the Community:[/h1]
Be sure to follow the Steam Community group here, and follow Grimm: Dark Legacy on Facebook and Twitter to keep up to date with the latest news and information.

We hope that you enjoy your many adventures as Grimm, and we're looking forward to updating Grimm: Dark Legacy with exciting new content soon.

[url=http://www.facebook.com/GrimmDarkLegacy]Join the conversation[/URL], we want your feedback.

Happy Hunting,
The Grimm: Dark Legacy Team.
